# Short title: what changed, in plain words

## What I did
2-4 sentences. What exists now that didn't before?

## Why
Why this approach, and not another one? What problem does it solve?

## How it works
The short version. A diagram or a few bullets is fine. Link the files involved.

## How to test it
Exact steps a teammate can follow to see it working on their machine.

## What I'd explain to a teammate
If someone asked "walk me through this", what would you tell them? Any line of code you can't explain here shouldn't be merged yet.

## Things I'm unsure about
Open questions, shortcuts taken, things that might break.
